alt: Table of what the GTA 6 stash bag glitch pays: Insider Gaming and Game Rant say each pickup adds the starting value, VICE says each pickup doubles the contents, Insider Gaming says about 8 to 12 pickups and Game Rant says about 12, VICE got $277,200 in one bag and says a full van is about $2.72 million, one unconfirmed player claim says $700,000 for two jewelry bags. Sources disagree. Not a game screenshot.
